WELCOME TO CENTRAL PA

Recreated in Minecraft!

Spawn on City Island, cross the Susquehanna River, and set off towards places you recognize!

The Harrisburg Area Minecraft Server is a long-term, community-focused survival experience built around a hand-crafted recreation of Central Pennsylvania. Settle down on your own land, start a town with friends, or explore!

This Server works on the latest verisions of Java and Bedro, meaning that anybody can play together!

WORLD SPAWN-POINT

Welcome to City Island.

Before Venturing into the wilderness to explore the world check out the spawn hub located at city island, and the star of the area, former spearker of the house Newt Gingrich 

SPAWN SPOTLIGHT ★
A VERY HARRISBURG EASTER EGG

The Temple of
Newt Gingrich.

The 50th Speaker of the House appears in our local-celebrity-inspired spawn lore — and City Island's historic bathhouse has become a temple in his honor.

Pretty Goofy ahhhhhh
01 / MARKET DISTRICT

Meet the locals.

Find NPCs inspired by figures and characters connected to the server’s local lore, including Shane Gillis, Jonathan Groff, Howard Hamlin, and Newt Gingrich. Some offer basic items; more trading options are planned.

02 / OUT INTO THE WORLD

Cross the river.

Bridges connect City Island to the wilderness. Boats at the docks let you set off along the Susquehanna.

03 / COMING EVENT

The End awaits.

The world has no naturally generated strongholds. The server's End portal is at spawn and will be opened for a community event when announced.
